name: CreateGadInstanceMember

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the central node. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 中心节点（主节点）所在地域ID，可调用DescribeRegions查询
parameters.name: central_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the central node . You can call the DescribeGadInstances operation to query the ID
parameters.name: central_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the global active database cluster. You can call the DescribeGadInstances operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: RDS全球多活数据库集群ID，可调用DescribeGadInstances查询
parameters.name: gad_instance_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the unit node that you want to create. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length.
The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.
The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
新建单元节点的名称。命名规则如下：
长度为2~255个字符。
以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
fields.name: db_instance_description

fields.help_en: The storage capacity of the unit node that you want to create. Unit: GB The storage capacity increases in increments of 5 GB. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html. You can also call the DescribeAvailableResource operation to query the storage capacity range that is supported by the new instance type
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点的存储空间大小。单位：GB。每5 GB进行递增，取值范围请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html。您也可以调用DescribeAvailableResource接口查询目标实例规格中可用的存储空间范围
fields.name: db_instance_storage

fields.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

local_ssd: local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
fields.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：

local_ssd：本地SSD盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
fields.name: db_instance_storage_type

fields.help_en: The instance type of the unit node that you want to create. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html. You can call the DescribeAvailableResource operation to query the available instance types in a region
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点的实例规格。取值详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html。您也可以调用DescribeAvailableResource接口查询目标地域中可用的实例规格列表
fields.name: db_instance_class

fields.help_en:
The conflict resolution policy based on which Data Transmission Service (DTS) responds to primary key conflicts during data synchronization to the unit node that you want to create. Valid values:

overwrite: DTS overwrites the conflicting primary key on the destination node.
interrupt: DTS stops the synchronization task, reports an error, and then exits.
ignore: DTS overwrites the conflicting primary key on the logger node
fields.help_zh:
新建单元节点在同步时发生主键冲突采取的修复策略。取值：
overwrite：覆盖目标节点中发生冲突的主键。
interrupt：中止同步任务，报错并退出。
ignore：覆盖当前节点中发生冲突的主键
fields.name: dts_conflict

fields.help_en:
The specifications of the data synchronization task for the unit node that you want to create. Valid values:

small
medium
large
micro

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
fields.help_zh:
新建单元节点的数据同步链路规格。取值：
small
medium
large
micro

关于各规格的区别，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
fields.name: dts_instance_class

fields.help_en: The database engine of the unit node that you want to create. Set the value to MySQL
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点的数据库引擎。当前仅支持MySQL
fields.name: engine

fields.help_en:
The database engine version of the unit node that you want to create. Valid values:

8.0
5.7
5.6
5.5

新建单元节点的数据库版本。取值：
8.0
5.7
5.6
5.5

fields.help_en: The region ID of the unit node or secondary node that you want to create. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点（备节点）所在的地域ID，可调用DescribeRegions查询
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html of the unit node that you want to create. If you want to add more than one entry to the IP address whitelist, separate the entries with commas (,). Each entry must be unique. The IP address whitelist can contain up to 1,000 entries. The entries in the IP address whitelist must be in one of the following formats:

IP addresses, such as `10.10.XX.XX`.
CIDR blocks, such as `10.10.XX.XX/24`. In this example, 24 indicates that the prefix of each IP address in the IP address whitelist is 24 bits in length. You can replace 24 with a value within the range of 1 to 32
fields.help_zh:
新建单元节点的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html。多条记录请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复，最多1000条记录。支持如下两种格式：
IP地址形式，例如：`10.10.XX.XX`。
CIDR形式，例如：`10.10.XX.XX/24`（无类域间路由，24表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为1~32）
fields.name: security_ip_list

fields.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the unit node that you want to create
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点的虚拟交换机（vSwitch） ID
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the unit node that you want to create
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点的专有网络（VPC）ID
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID of the unit node that you want to create. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID
fields.help_zh: 新建单元节点所在的可用区ID，可调用DescribeRegions查询
fields.name: zone_id

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the secondary node of the unit node that you want to create. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID.

If the value of this parameter is the same as the zone ID of the unit node that you want to create, the single-zone deployment method is used.
If the value of this parameter is different from the zone ID of the unit node that you want to create, the multiple-zone deployment method is used
fields.help_zh:
新建单元节点的备节点可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions查询。
如果和当前单元节点的ZoneId相同，则为单可用区部署。
如果和当前单元节点的ZoneId不同，则为多可用区部署
fields.name: zone_id_slave_1

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the logger node of the unit node that you want to create. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID.

If the value of this parameter is the same as the zone ID of the unit node that you want to create, the single-zone deployment method is used.
If the value of this parameter is different from the zone ID of the unit node that you want to create, the multiple-zone deployment method is used
fields.help_zh:
新建单元节点的日志节点可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions查询。
如果和当前单元节点的ZoneId相同，则为单可用区部署。
如果和当前单元节点的ZoneId不同，则为多可用区部署
fields.name: zone_id_slave_2

parameters.help_zh: 单元节点（备节点）信息列表

parameters.help_zh: 中心节点的高权限账号，可调用DescribeAccounts查询

parameters.help_zh: 中心节点的高权限账号对应的密码
parameters.name: central_rds_dts_admin_password

parameters.help_en:
A JSON array that consists of the information about the databases on the central node. All database information that you specify in this array is synchronized to the unit nodes of the global active database cluster. The JSON array contains the following fields:

name: the name of the database.
all: specifies whether to synchronize all data in the database or the table. Valid values: true and false.
Table: the name of the table. If you set the all field to false, you must nest the name of the table that you want to synchronize into the JSON array.

Example: `{ "testdb": { "name": "testdb", "all": false, "Table": { "order": { "name": "order", "all": true }, "ordernew": { "name": "ordernew", "all": true } } } }`

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html
parameters.name: db_list
